import polars as pl
import re
from datetime import datetime
import math


def transform(raw: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    # Replace common placeholder strings with nulls across all columns
    placeholders = r"^(?:N/A|n/a|-|null|)$"
    cleaned = raw.with_columns(
        pl.all().str.replace(placeholders, None)
    )

    return cleaned.select(
        account=pl.col("@Account").str.strip_chars(),
        txn_date=pl.col("Date").str.to_date(format="%d/%m/%Y", strict=False),
        description=pl.col("Details").str.strip_chars(),
        amount=pl.col("Amount").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).round(2),
        balance=pl.col("Balance").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).round(2),
        reference=pl.col("Reference").str.strip_chars(),
    )
